compute_dice_loss: compute the DICE loss between predicted masks and ground truth target masks
compute_sigmoid_ce_loss: compute the sigmoid cross entropy loss between predicted logits and binary target masks
calculate_uncertainty: calculate uncertainty scores from logit predictions using L1 distance from zero
create_setcriterion: create a SetCriterion module to compute Hungarian assignment and loss for MaskFormer models
run_setcriterion_forward: run the SetCriterion forward pass to compute classification and mask losses for model outputs
